links.outcome: LLM psychiatric classification accuracy across sex, age, and race subgroups
links.effect: Higher depression-classification accuracy among male than female participants, no consistent age-related pattern, and modest non-uniform variation across race strata.
links.quote: Subgroup analyses found higher depression-classification accuracy among male than female participants, no consistent age-related pattern, and modest non-uniform variation across race strata.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs on a benchmark of 555 semi-structured psychiatric interviews to assess diagnostic screening accuracy, demographic equity, and evidence-weighting patterns.
